kind: Read-only hosted inventory; not an authenticated user-journey test
query: select now() as observed_at_utc, (now() at time zone 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur')::date as eligibility_date_malaysia, (select jsonb_build_object('total',count(*),'eligible',count(*) filter(where status='Active' and (deadline is null or deadline >= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur')::date)),'expired_active',count(*) filter(where status='Active' and deadline < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur')::date),'closed',count(*) filter(where status='Closed')) from public.job_postings) as job_counts, (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('job_posting_id',job_posting_id,'title',title,'deadline',deadline)) from public.job_postings where status='Active' and (deadline is null or deadline >= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur')::date)) as eligible_postings, (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.proname,'body_md5',md5(p.prosrc),'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'config',p.proconfig)) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname in ('score_compatibility','calculate_recommendations_for_user','get_skill_analysis_for_job')) as recommendation_functions;
limitations: Eligible does not mean verified vacancy or safe synthetic test data.
No user accounts, jobs, applications, auth settings or database schema were changed.
Function-body parity covers only the three recommendation functions, not full deployment parity.
